description: This file defines a React functional component 'NoteForm' that provides a user interface for creating, summarizing, and saving notes. It manages state for title, content, summary, loading status, and toast notifications, and interacts with external API functions 'summarizeText' and 'saveNote'.

methods.name: NoteForm
methods.description: React functional component for note creation, summarization, and saving.

methods.name: showToast
methods.description: Displays a toast message with auto-hide functionality.

methods.name: handleSummarize
methods.description: Handles the summarization of note content by calling 'summarizeText' API.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Handles saving the note by calling 'saveNote' API and invoking 'onSaved' callback.
